'''Iğdır Futbol Kulübü''', known as '''Alagöz Holding Iğdır Futbol Kulübü''' due to sponsorship reasons, is a Turkish professional football club based in [[Iğdır]]. They play in the [[TFF First League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ajansspor.com/haber/igdir-belediyespor-tff-3lige-yukseldi-577817|title=Iğdır Belediyespor TFF 3.Lig'e Yükseldi|website=ajansspor.com}}</ref> The club plays in green and white kits."}}
